title: Qualify the candidate on physical iOS Metal devices
requires: Every registered physical iOS/iPadOS target and deployment/signing toolchain
scope: F8 INTEGRATION GATE: qualify only realtime-single-step-v1-5bacbe2, manifest 29e051d94a89a39d51c2128b212165d60da6da7de4b2c107a72ae7cc5b77f20a, source 5bacbe2b1e0fbfad565fb9477bb6873396e31d5d, tree 67f5088c2e9f50938c55856e3683326e42675310 and exact-source CI run 41708083151. This is the API 0.3/driver ABI 2 sole fixed-tick SDK/Gallery integration contract with 49 capabilities, 30 public cases, 12 scenarios and 37 measurements. Candidate v9 realtime-single-step-v1-ba67db3 remains immutable rejected/superseded history after its Metal and Windows failures; its completed CPU, CUDA and Vulkan rows cannot be unioned with v10. Preserve one 1/60 step, one spatial publication, all correctness/recovery/work budgets and the 2026-11-03 timing deferral. Timing-only misses belong to F9-07/F9-08. Execute every registered physical iOS/iPadOS Metal tuple; simulator is not a substitute.
acceptance: F8-74 freezes exact candidate realtime-single-step-v1-5bacbe2, manifest 29e051d94a89a39d51c2128b212165d60da6da7de4b2c107a72ae7cc5b77f20a, source 5bacbe2b1e0fbfad565fb9477bb6873396e31d5d, tree 67f5088c2e9f50938c55856e3683326e42675310 and protected CI run 41708083151; execute only that identity and never union historical observations.

Run every applicable kernel/variant, domain, coupling, lifecycle and negative case. Complete execution, physical/numerical correctness, capability, independent work-budget and recovery assertions must pass; classify every failure.
Prove one dt=1/60 advance and one spatial publication per tick; verify interpolation, overload slow-motion, no catch-up and fixed dispatch/iteration/submission/readback/synchronization budgets.

Retain all frozen workload timing samples and stalls. Report CPU/GPU/physics/frame p50/p95/p99 and simulated/wall ratio. Timing target misses are disclosed F9-07/F9-08 debt and are not F8 integration failures.

Attach reviewable artifacts identifying exact candidate, binary/deployment, device/OS/GPU/driver/toolchain and manifest hashes. Preserve failures; do not weaken physics, workload, tolerance, timeout or advertised capability.
Use normal public simulation creation with the sole schedule and no execution-profile opt-in. Verify all applicable supported domains/interactions and installed Gallery behavior.
evidence: PASS: exact candidate realtime-single-step-v1-5bacbe2, manifest 29e051d94a89a39d51c2128b212165d60da6da7de4b2c107a72ae7cc5b77f20a, source 5bacbe2b1e0fbfad565fb9477bb6873396e31d5d and tree 67f5088c2e9f50938c55856e3683326e42675310 ran on physical iPad13,8 / Apple M1 / iPadOS 27.0.1 through the exact signed Metal runtime.

PASS: independent frozen validation reports 12 scenarios, 37 measurements, 49 capabilities, 30 public cases and five rejected negative controls with zero failures. Four target-tier workloads in plain and validation modes completed 57600 measured ticks and retained 230400 timing values with zero failed ticks.

PERFORMANCE PASS: all eight workload executions satisfy 8.5 ms physics p95 and 0.99 simulated/wall targets. Worst p95 is 5.025583 ms; minimum ratio is 4.203325. Stalls above p99 remain in raw evidence.

SCOPED GALLERY: all 28 installed Gallery scenes ran 120 frames and every control/lifecycle check passed. The additional fluid-rope analytic profile preserves three quality failures under F9-02/F9-05; extended rope diagnostics preserve 84 public-estimated versus 83 native dispatches under F9-05. Native work is lower and within the unchanged budget.
